Prayer:
texts.facts: 3. W.P.Nos.19028 and 23768 of 2023 have been filed to issue direction to the respondents to issue Formal Appointment Orders to the Petitioners who were declared as newly selected Food Safety Officers as they were already selected, sent for training and on successful completion of the same they are waiting for the Appointment Orders. 4. Since all the above petitions are filed seeking certain reliefs against the impugned order of the Medical Services Recruitment Board dated 13.03.2023, they are all disposed of by way of this Common Order. 5. The Petitioners have applied for the post of Food Safety Officer vide Notification No.02/MRB/2021 dated 13.10.2021. Note: Candidate should have studied Tamil as one of the subject in HSC. 6. The petitioners though provisionally selected, the selection has been withheld for the production of Equivalence Certificate. In the said G.O., the Government also directed the general public / students / teachers / colleges / Universities / Recruitment boards / other stakeholders who seek equivalence of the courses offered by the Colleges / Universities to address the Tamil Nadu State council for Higher Education, directly. Having regard to the stand taken by the Respondents particularly, MSRB and the State Government this Court has suo motu impleaded the Union of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to determine the equivalence of the educational qualification of the candidates as per the letter of the Tamilnadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department dated 28.03.2023 and this Court is also made it clear that MSRB shall not take https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.9668, 9705, 9710, 9750, 11187, 11190,19028 and 23768 of 2023 and W.M.P.Nos. 9720, 9722, 9723, 9772, 9773, 9834, 9836, 9837, 9840, 11061, 11062 and 23285 of 2023 any decision entailing adverse civil consequences to the petitioners without prior permission of this Court until further orders. As per the above Order, no report has been filed.
